fusions.name: Inside the Breastplate
fusions.desc: A bite delivered from inside the target's plate: it deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gnawed Buckles
fusions.desc: Bites at straps and buckles in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose-Fit Mail
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Scrap Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures armour pieced from gnawed scrap: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
